official_observations: LiangZhu.use opens showMultiSelWindow and passes getMultiSelectDatas into showDatas. The options are draw1, let the recovered seat draw2, and cancel. isTriggerAutoUse returns true.

WindowManager.showMultiSelWindow uses SpellMultiSelectorWindow for skill250. SpellMultiSelectorWindow.showDatas calls setSkillTitle(skill:getName()) and displays the supplied option message. It is not a nameless target-only prompt.
ShanJiaJL uses ShaTargetSelector and regards the card as SHA. spell1762.ActiveTip is 请选择一个目标视为对其使用一张杀. Its AskTip is 发动将灵技能：{Skill}.
Skill.getAskTip falls back to 是否发动%s when AskTip is absent. ActiveTip absence does not instruct an adapter to discard the skill name.
local_causes: The generic classifier includes 是否发动【技能】. The unmatched ActiveTip fallback replaced that heading with a target/card instruction without the skill name. The normal skill-description detail was also filtered out.

chooseUseTarget creates chooseTarget with _get_card and a default title translating the entire VCard. The previous adapter recognized only a generic title plus a specific prompt2; therefore titles like 选择杀【◈】的目标 bypassed official adaptation.

jiang0_rule_<id> is a protected global rule without lib.translate. Its active loadout context provides GameSkillID and SkillName; matching by the normal translated name failed and could not distinguish the official JiangLing version.
ActiveTip can describe a different choice phase or fixed count. Previous matching did not reject most card-versus-target or count conflicts.
adaptation: All unmatched generic skill choices retain the known skill name. Choice controls keep their original skill question.

Read only the actual active jiangling row and validate both official ID and name. Preserve custom prompts; normalize only exact native chooseUseTarget defaults. No rule, target filter, result, or foreign extension is rewritten.
Reject templates incompatible with the local choice kind and explicit counts. Preserve unresolved multi-branch templates and unknown parameters as native text rather than guessing a branch.
A specific native instruction containing additional restrictions is retained. Native details with extra conditions remain visible.

Zero-card/zero-target costs are omitted from combined choices. Infinite upper ranges retain their actual meaning instead of falling back to one target. Choice controls request an option rather than a card.

verification.scope: Headless Edge, actual noname entry and choice content; actual sp liangzhu content; actual jiang0 active-loadout context and ShanJia rule, with drawing/activation presentation excluded and card settlement paused at the target choice. All3732 prompt entries are inventoried, with3420 skill entries checked across8 synthetic event kinds for fallback identity, template residue and custom-condition preservation. This is not a claim that all skills were played or every official dynamic protocol branch was reproduced.

legacy_fixture_failure.boundary: The script strips imports while injecting the external Lei Yi Jiang shunchai module. Actual import-based gainPlayerCard/miyun engine verification passed. This fixture is not counted as passing.
